mapper.select: SELECT game_id, equipment_key, name, description, created_at, updated_at FROM public.equipment WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND equipment_key = #{equipmentKey} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM public.equipment WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND equipment_key = #{equipmentKey}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.equipment (game_id, equipment_key, name, description) VALUES (#{gameId}, #{equipmentKey}, #{name}, #{description})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM public.equipment WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND equipment_key = #{equipmentKey}
mapper.select: SELECT attribute_key, value_type, min_value, max_value FROM public.attributes WHERE game_id = #{gameId} ORDER BY sort_order ASC, name ASC, attribute_key ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.equipment_attributes (game_id, equipment_key, attribute_values) VALUES (#{gameId}, #{equipmentKey}, CAST(#{attributeValuesJson} AS jsonb))
